verdict.rationale: Abacum has a dedicated Excel connector page stating users can "push and pull data seamlessly between Excel and Abacum" and "keep Excel in use." That covers the bi-directional Excel workflow the story describes, and the story's 'Excel or Google Sheets' wording means Excel alone satisfies it. The evidence is only two marketing lines, though. missing for 10: in-depth connector documentation (add-in install, live refresh behavior, write-back permissions and validation), any evidence of a Google Sheets equivalent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
